parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Optional. Search by return ID or order number.

parameters.name: filter[status]
parameters.description: Optional. Filter by return status (e.g. INITIATED, RECEIVED, CANCELLED).

parameters.name: filter[refund_status]
parameters.description: Optional. Filter by refund status (e.g. REFUND_INITIATED, REFUND_PROCESSED, REFUND_DECLINED).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Optional. Sort field. Prefix with - for descending. Available: id, created_at, updated_at.
